question: Closing the REST /intents routes for scoped runs also blocks the investigator's own context assembly: cwft-mctl-agents-investigate.yaml sets WORK_ITEM_INTENT_SOURCE=on with MCTL_RUN_TOKEN_MODE=enforce, so the pod reads GET /api/v1/work-items/{id}/intents with the scoped run token, and a referenced intent it cannot read fails the run (intent-unresolved). How should that consumer be handled?
reason: The proposal assumes WORK_ITEM_INTENT_SOURCE is set to off in mctl-gitops before the mctl-api release. The template says this is byte-neutral, and the prompt stays unchanged because context mode is shadow. The cost is that sealed snapshots no longer include intents. If the owner wants intents kept in snapshots, mctl-agents needs a separate credential that the model cannot reach, and that changes the sequencing.

options: Set WORK_ITEM_INTENT_SOURCE=off first; snapshots lose intents
Keep intents in snapshots via a separate non-model credential (new mctl-agents/mctl-api work first)
Ship mctl-api first and accept intent-unresolved failures until the flag is flipped
